columns.name: WA_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a WhatsApp template in Recruiting

columns.name: WABA_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Name assigned to the WhatsApp template

columns.name: WABA_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the WhatsApp template. Possible values include ORA_MARKETING, ORA_UTILITY, ORA_AUTHENTICATION

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Recruiting category for the WhatsApp template

columns.name: DESC_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the description library item associated with this version. Foreign key, references description_version_id in the irc_desc_versions_b table

columns.name: TEMPLATE_STATUS
columns.description: Recruiting template status, allowing suspension from FA without affecting Meta's status. Possible values include ORA_ACTIVE, ORA_INACTIVE

columns.name: PRODUCT_CONTEXT
columns.description: The product context such as HCM_COMMUNICATE, HCM_RECRUITING etc., for which the template belongs to.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates whether the template was created via content library import, FSM Import, or the UI. Possible values include ORA_CONTENT_LIBRARY_IMPORT, ORA_FSM_IMPORT, ORA_UI

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
